title: Book Three · Chapter 63: The First Full Sentence
story:
On Monday, Kai comes to Ronan's desk at lunch.

He has his story book and a clean page. There are four sentences on it.

“You said one,” Ronan says.

“I know. They came together.”

Ronan moves his lunch box aside and looks. The first sentence gives the man's reason. The next two point to things in the story.

The last sentence starts with he. Ronan reads the sentence again.

“Which man is this?” he asks.

Kai looks at the line. There are two men in that part of the story.

“The older one.”

“Put that there.”

Kai changes the beginning. Then he reads all four sentences aloud.

This time, Ronan can follow the people from start to end. One sentence is still long. Kai makes a mark where he wants to split it.

“Try two,” Ronan says.

“I need air,” Kai says. He takes another breath, then draws the line between the two ideas.

Kai writes them below. He reads again, more slowly.

Anna comes back from Lin's desk with her notebook. She listens to the last part.

“That is much clearer.”

Kai looks at his page. “It started badly.”

“You brought it,” Ronan says.

He points to the first line. Kai looks at it for another moment, then puts the pencil down.

Their ten minutes are nearly finished. Ronan opens his lunch. Kai goes to get his own box and brings it back.

At the afternoon lesson, the teacher asks about the same story. Kai raises his hand once.

He gives his reason and one detail. He pauses before the second. The teacher waits, and he finishes.

Ronan sees Kai's shoulders drop a little when he sits down.

After school, Kai catches him near the stairs.

“I still need help with the next one,” he says.

“So do I.”

Kai looks surprised.

Ronan takes out another page. His own next answer has a question mark beside the middle.

“The story says two things. I'm not sure about this part.”

Kai points back toward the classroom.

“Ask now?”

The teacher is still inside. The boys return and ask one short question. They leave with a page number to read again.

Outside, Anna is waiting near the gate. Lin has already gone home. Anna asks about Ronan's run tomorrow.

“One lap?”

“Two, unless you hide the bench.”

She laughs. Kai goes toward his own road, still reading the new page number.

Ronan walks with Anna to the crossing. The air is cooler now. She carries her drawings against her coat, and he carries the story book open to the right place.

At the corner, he closes it and looks up. Anna has stopped to wait for the road to clear.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

reason＝原因、理由；split＝拆开、分开；raise one's hand＝举手；unless＝除非。

## 理解问题

1. Kai周末有没有先自己尝试写？这次Ronan主要帮他明确了什么？
2. Kai在课堂上有了什么小变化？Ronan对自己的不确定部分怎样处理？

## 读句子

**Kai changes the beginning.**

拆开看：Kai / changes / the beginning.

Kai／改了／句子的开头。
